name: FV_TR_FED_ACCOUNT_SYMBOLS_
description: This table contains Federal U.S. Standard General Ledger Account Information.

columns.name: FED_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL_ID
columns.description: Identifier for Federal Account Symbol.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AGENCY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the type of agency as either internal or trading partner.

columns.name: AGENCY_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component that identifies the agency that is responsible for the budget account.

columns.name: MAIN_ACCOUNT_CODE
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component that represents the type and purpose of the fund.

columns.name: FED_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL_TITLE
columns.description: The title of the Federal Account Symbol assigned by Treasury. Federal Account Symbols constitute the "basic" elements of the Treasury Account Symbol . For example, appropriation and fund accounts are listed with an agency identifier and main account code; no-year accounts include the "X." Receipt accounts are listed with the main account and sub-account code.

columns.name: NON_FED_EXCEPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies if a Federal Account Symbol is exempt from requiring non Federal trading partners to make advances for reimbursable work.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
